content.title: About
content.content: Cereal Rice Crispy Flavored are crunchy dry flakes made from whole grain rice, coated with a flavoring. They prepare quickly with just milk or yogurt and are suitable for breakfast or a snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole‑grain rice flakes retain most of the grain’s nutrients.
Flavorings can be natural (e.g., vanilla, strawberry) or artificial.
The product is often used in children’s meals because of its soft texture and mild taste.
Rice flakes are easily digestible and suitable for people with gluten intolerance.
The original recipe contains only rice, sugar, salt, and flavoring.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The flakes contain a small amount of fat, making them suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Rice flakes provide quick‑release carbs that supply fast energy.

items.title: Gluten‑free
items.content: When produced correctly, the product is free of gluten, important for those with celiac disease.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Their soft structure makes them easy on the stomach, beneficial for children and seniors.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Small amounts of B1 and B3 vitamins may be present, supporting metabolism.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Flavored flakes often contain added sugar, which can contribute to weight gain if consumed in excess.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Flavorings may contain traces of nuts, dairy, or soy, which can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Rice flakes raise blood sugar quickly, a consideration for people with diabetes.

items.title: Possible additives
items.content: Some versions include artificial colors and preservatives that may not suit everyone.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour milk, kefir, yogurt, or a plant‑based drink over the flakes, add fruit, nuts, or honey. They are also used in desserts, bars, and as a crunchy topping for baked goods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package. For long‑term storage, keep in the refrigerator to prevent moisture absorption and loss of crispness.
